title: Akeredolu Remembered as Visionary Advocate for State Police and Federalism
text:
The posthumous 70th birthday colloquium for Oluwarotimi Akeredolu highlighted his significant contributions to Nigerian governance, particularly his championing of state policing and regional security initiatives. Dignitaries from across the political spectrum and civil society paid tribute to his lasting impact on the country's security architecture.
Governors, former governors, the pan-Yoruba socio-cultural organisation Afenifere, the Nigerian Bar Association (NBA), and the Development Agenda for Western Nigeria (DAWN) Commission joined forces to honour the late Ondo State Governor, Oluwarotimi Akeredolu.
At a posthumous 70th birthday colloquium held at the University of Ibadan, attendees praised Akeredolu's courage, visionary leadership, and relentless advocacy for state police and true federalism. His legacy was underscored by his critical role in establishing the Amotekun security network, which has since become a model for decentralised policing in Nigeria.
